results.question: Plot daily revenue from December 25 through December 31, 2025
results.sql: SELECT CAST(o.order_date AS VARCHAR) AS "label", SUM(o.net_amount) AS "value" FROM orders o WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-12-25' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY o.order_date ORDER BY o.order_date

results.question: Compare total 2025 revenue across all regions
results.sql: SELECT r.region_name AS "label", SUM(o.net_amount) AS "value" FROM regions r JOIN customers c ON r.region_id = c.region_id JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY r.region_id, r.region_name ORDER BY "value" DESC

results.question: Plot the monthly number of website sessions during 2025
results.sql: SELECT STRFTIME(c.date, '%Y-%m') AS "label", COUNT(s.session_id) AS "value" FROM calendar c LEFT JOIN sessions s ON c.date = s.session_date WHERE c.calendar_year = 2025 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

results.question: Rank the 10 highest spending customers in 2025
results.sql: SELECT t1.customer_name AS "label", SUM(t2.net_amount) AS "value" FROM customers AS t1 JOIN orders AS t2 ON t1.customer_id = t2.customer_id WHERE t2.status = 'completed' GROUP BY t1.customer_id, t1.customer_name ORDER BY "value" DESC LIMIT 10

results.question: Compare revenue across every product category during 2025
results.sql: SELECT c.category_name AS "label", SUM(oi.net_amount) AS "value" FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY c.category_name ORDER BY "value" DESC
